item.title: Camping Tent Outdoor Waterproof
item.description: This SKU (YCS-OUT-003) is sourced from audited Chinese factories with AQL 2.5 quality control and DDP shipping to 50+ countries. For fitness brands, gym suppliers, and e-commerce sellers, Camping Tent Outdoor Waterproof (SKU YCS-OUT-003) delivers commercial-grade durability at $5.66 USD per unit. Tested for high-intensity use and built for repeat orders. Sourced from verified Outdoor manufacturers with on-site audit. A 3-stage QC pipeline — IQC incoming-material, IPQC in-line at 4 checkpoints, OQC pre-shipment — runs on every batch, with 20-page photo + video inspection reports shared before the balance payment milestone. Compliance documents available on request.
